# Migration Plan: next 14.2.28 → 15.5.27

## Summary

Upgrade `next` from version `14.2.28` to `15.5.27`.

## Required Changes

- **[high]** `packages/nextjs/package.json` — Upgrade `next` from `^14.0.4` to `15.5.27`. Update peer dependencies (`react`, `react-dom`, `eslint-config-next`) accordingly.
- **[medium]** `packages/nextjs/next.config.js` — Review Next.js configuration options that changed between 14.2.28 and 15.5.27 (e.g. experimental flags, image domains, webpack config).
